title: lint-dirsize fails at HEAD b9e6f80: packages/meeting-bot/src/calendar holds 31 files against a budget of 30, so the unit's own new test had to go in the join-rules-wiring subdirectory
evidence: node scripts/lint-dirsize.mjs prints 'packages/meeting-bot/src/calendar: 31 files (budget 30)' on an unmodified checkout of b9e6f80 (this lane added no top-level file). apps/api/src (32/31) and apps/api/src/routes (32/30) also exceed. Not caused by this lane.
fix_direction: Move a cohesive group of calendar files into a subdirectory (as join-rules-wiring/, alerts/, link-source/ were); needs a quiet moment because held lanes alerttenant, tombstone and everytrust edit files at that level.

title: W6 (recurring series) cannot be built inside packages/meeting-bot/src/calendar: the scheduled item carries no series id, and what an opt-out of a series should mean is a product choice
evidence: AutoRecordItem has sessionKey/source/sourceId/title/times/meetingUrl/sender only; CalendarEvent.recurringEventId is dropped in normalizeCalendarEvent (sourceId = e.id, the instance id). applyJoinRules therefore cannot offer a series id to the evaluator. An opt-out recorded for a series id does not remove an instance (exact, case-sensitive id match, contract W6).
fix_direction: Approver decides whether opting out a series id removes all its instances (and whether the Calendar page may record a series id). Then: add an optional seriesId to AutoRecordItem (core), fill it in auto-join.ts (everytrust lane), and offer it as an extra id in join-rules-select.ts siblingIds. Until then the Calendar page records instance ids, which already work.
